day_local: Inuusiq Saint Josaphat, Bishop amma Martyr
greeting: Ataniup atii, Ataata, Erniq, amma Anirniq Pijunnaitumik. Taima, asanniktuq Ataniq ilissinniippili.
penitential: Ataniq, ungasiktumut nalliginiq ilingnut. Kristu, nalliginiq ilingnut. Ataniq, nalliginiq ilingnut.
psalm_response: Pijunnaitumik pilirijuk Ataniq, ikajurti Jacob-up Ataniq.
homily:
Pivalliajut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Qiviartariaqarpugut silami, qanuq inuusiq takujariaqarpugut. Paulusa titiraqtuq Philemon-mut, uqaqtuq: 'I have experienced much joy and encouragement from your love, because the hearts of the holy ones have been refreshed by you, brother.' Taanna uqausiq, 'refreshed by you,' qanuippa? Taanna uqausiq takujariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq. Ilisimaliqput inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat, qanuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Taimanna atautikkut, qaujimajavut qanugitilluta. Benjamin, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik uqalaurmat, quviasulluni. Taanna qajuqtuq inuusiup iluani, ataniup asannininga ilisimallugu. Ilisimaliqput taanna asanniniq, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut. 

Alan and Thao, I know the weight of these past four months. I know the way the world can seem to lose its color when you are carrying such a heavy cross. But look at the Gospel, look at the way Jesus speaks of the Kingdom: 'The coming of the Kingdom of God cannot be observed... For behold, the Kingdom of God is among you.' The Kingdom is not something you chase down the road; it is the presence of love that remains even when the body is gone. Benjamin is there, resting in the light, smiling that gentle, brilliant smile. He is not lost; he is found in the heart of the Father. Ryan, my dear brother, your brother Ben loved you. He was your partner. When you look at the sky, when you see a plane soaring high, remember that Ben's spirit is soaring too. He is free, he is full of light, and he is watching over you with a bright, gentle smile. 

Kikkut ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kikkut uqalurialiqtut iluani, nalligivikluq ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilissik ilisimajariaqarpugut asanniniq aniguqtilaaqtuq. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut Benjamin, qaujimajavut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. There is a memory that stays with me, a small, quiet moment that reveals the depth of his spirit. You remember the offer he made, unprompted, to give his entire piggy bank to his uncle William. He didn't break it. He didn't empty it. He didn't need to. The offer itself was the truth of his soul. It was the declaration of a boy who knew that everything he had—every coin, every dream, every hour of his life—was meant to be poured out for those he loved. 

I know the temptation, Alan and Thao, to look back at the last year and wonder if you missed a sign, if there was some hidden path that could have led to a different outcome. Let me lift that stone from your heart today. Neither this man nor his parents sinned. Illness is never a punishment, and it is never the fault of those who loved and cared for the one who suffered. You missed nothing. You are not to blame. God does not accuse you, and you must not accuse yourselves. You were the best parents he could have had. You were his comfort, his partners in travel, the ones who listened to his dreams of airplanes and shared his laughter. You are absolved of that guilt. Lay it down. It is not yours to carry. 

Benjamin is not a memory. He is a life that has been transformed, not ended. He is a part of the 'perfect four' that exists in the heart of God. He is watching over you, Alan, Thao, and Ryan, with that same gentle, braces-filled smile that used to light up a room. He is cheering for you as you navigate this new, difficult landscape. He is waiting for you at the finish line, where the math will finally make sense, where the planes will all be on time, and where there will be no more goodbyes. 

So, what do you carry out the door today? Carry the freedom of the healed. You have been loved by a boy who knew how to give everything away, and you are loved by a God who gave His own Son so that you would never be alone. When you feel the ache, breathe in the grace of that reality. When you feel the weight, remember that you are an heir to eternal life. You are held. You are seen. You are home, even when you are walking through the dark. And that is enough. That is everything.
spiritual_communion: My Jesus, I believe that You are present in the Most Holy Sacrament. I love You above all things, and I desire to receive You into my soul. Since I cannot at this moment receive You sacramentally, come at least spiritually into my heart. I embrace You as if You were already there and unite myself wholly to You. Never permit me to be separated from You. Amen.
closing: May the peace of the Lord, which surpasses all understanding, guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin-mut amma tamainnut tukumirsimajunut, Kristup qaujimajaujut qaujimajaujut qaujimajaujut qaujimajaujut qaujimajaujut qaujimajaujut.
Tamainnut uqumaittumik atuqtunut, Ataniq quviasungnirmik amma ikajurnirmik tunijaupali.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text: Beloved: I have experienced much joy and encouragement from your love, because the hearts of the holy ones have been refreshed by you, brother. Therefore, although I have the full right in Christ to order you to do what is proper, I rather urge you out of love, being as I am, Paul, an old man, and now also a prisoner for Christ Jesus. I urge you on behalf of my child Onesimus, whose father I have become in my imprisonment, who was once useless to you but is now useful to both you and me. I am sending him, that is, my own heart, back to you. I should have liked to retain him for myself, so that he might serve me on your behalf in my imprisonment for the Gospel, but I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that the good you do might not be forced but voluntary. Perhaps this is why he was away from you for a while, that you might have him back forever, no longer as a slave but more than a slave, a brother, beloved especially to me, but even more so to you, as a man and in the Lord. So if you regard me as a partner, welcome him as you would me. And if he has done you any injustice or owes you anything, charge it to me. I, Paul, write this in my own hand: I will pay. May I not tell you that you owe me your very self. Yes, brother, may I profit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text: R. Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob. The LORD secures justice for the oppressed, gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets captives free. R. Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob. The LORD gives sight to the blind. The LORD raises up those who were bowed down; the LORD loves the just. The LORD protects strangers. R. Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob. The fatherless and the widow he sustains, but the way of the wicked he thwarts. The LORD shall reign forever; your God, O Zion, through all generations. Alleluia. R. Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: Asked by the Pharisees when the Kingdom of God would come, Jesus said in reply, “The coming of the Kingdom of God cannot be observed, and no one will announce, ‘Look, here it is,’ or, ‘There it is.’ For behold, the Kingdom of God is among you.” Then he said to his disciples, “The days will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it. There will be those who will say to you, ‘Look, there he is,’ or ‘Look, here he is.’ Do not go off, do not run in pursuit. For just as lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one side to the other, so will the Son of Man be in his day. But first he must suffer greatly and be rejected by this generation.”

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
